card.name: Ninety-degree needle angle wording
card.fires_on: The word or symbol for degrees (or the 0 in 90) in an injection angle such as 90° to the skin. It also fires on nearby words that finish the angle phrase.

modes.label: Degree marker after 90
modes.description: The degree sign, the word degree, or the 0 of 90 in a needle angle instruction.
modes.example: Place the orange needle guard flat against the skin (90‑<<degree>> angle).

modes.label: Angle phrase endings
modes.description: Words that close an angle or orientation phrase, such as angle or plane, in device positioning steps.
modes.example: Aim and firmly jab the Green Tip straight down (at a 90°<< angle>>) against the mid-lateral thigh.

card.plain: It marks the spot in injector instructions where the needle is held at a right angle to the skin.
